title: Kabaaru weltaare e nder duuɓi mawɗi
intro: Aɗa seedtoo sahaa mo yaakaare ɓuuɓnata. Debbo, ɓooyɗo duuɓi jibinannde, ina heɓa fodoore nde luutndii sariyaaji tago. E nder ma66e ina darii 6icfcfo mo woodgol mum tigi woni maande yurmeende Alla – ruuhu 6urcfo teegtude e annabaagal, jogiicfo 6amtaare nde 6amtata yontaaji. Hol oo neɗɗo kaawningol?
clues: Mi jibinaa ko e jibnaaɓe ɓe njottii duuɓi, ɓe ngalaa ɓiɓɓe.
Jibineede am ko maleykaaji ngari hoɓɓe e galle am anndini ɗum.
Mi hokkaama hakkille e annabaagal, mi siftinee e nder muñɓe.
Baaba am wiyetee ko sehil Alla, ko miin wonno dokkal makko e duuɓi makko cakkitiiɗi ɗii.
Miɗo joginoo miñi am ko annabi kadi, min ɗiɗo fof min barkinii Joomiraawo amen.
Ɓiyam kadi ko annabi, iwdi am ndokkaama binndol e annabaagal.

outcome.label: Keeɓal
options: O rokkaama mbaawka haalde ko o cukalel

arabic: ٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ ٱلَّذِى وَهَبَ لِى عَلَى ٱلْكِبَرِ إِسْمَـٰعِيلَ وَإِسْحَـٰقَ ۚ إِنَّ رَبِّى لَسَمِيعُ ٱلدُّعَآءِ
verse: Praise to Allāh, who has granted to me in old age Ishmael and Isaac. Indeed, my Lord is the Hearer of supplication. (14:39)
